name: io.github.Antonytm/mcp-sitecore-server
description: Sitecore Community MCP: read/write access to SitecoreAI and Sitecore XM/XP over the Item Service, GraphQL Edge and Sitecore PowerShell Extensions

environment_variables.name: TRANSPORT
environment_variables.description: Transport to serve: 'stdio' or 'streamable-http' (port 3001, MCP at /mcp)

environment_variables.name: GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT
environment_variables.description: GraphQL endpoint URL for the Sitecore instance

environment_variables.name: GRAPHQL_SCHEMAS
environment_variables.description: Comma-separated Sitecore GraphQL schemas to expose

environment_variables.name: GRAPHQL_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: API key for the GraphQL endpoint, sent as an HTTP header

environment_variables.name: GRAPHQL_HEADERS
environment_variables.description: Additional headers to include in GraphQL requests

environment_variables.name: ITEM_SERVICE_DOMAIN
environment_variables.description: Domain for Item Service authentication

environment_variables.name: ITEM_SERVICE_USERNAME
environment_variables.description: Username for Item Service authentication

environment_variables.name: ITEM_SERVICE_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Password for Item Service authentication

environment_variables.name: ITEM_SERVICE_SERVER_URL
environment_variables.description: Base URL for the Item Service API

environment_variables.name: POWERSHELL_DOMAIN
environment_variables.description: Domain for Sitecore PowerShell Remoting authentication

environment_variables.name: POWERSHELL_USERNAME
environment_variables.description: Username for Sitecore PowerShell Remoting authentication

environment_variables.name: POWERSHELL_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Password for Sitecore PowerShell Remoting authentication

environment_variables.name: POWERSHELL_SERVER_URL
environment_variables.description: Base URL for the Sitecore PowerShell Remoting API

environment_variables.name: TOOL_GROUPS
environment_variables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of tool groups to register; unset registers every group

environment_variables.name: DISABLED_TOOLS
environment_variables.description: Comma-separated list of exact tool names to leave unregistered

environment_variables.name: TOOL_PROFILE
environment_variables.description: Preset denylist for a platform: 'xp' (or unset) disables nothing, 'sai' (SitecoreAI) hides the CM-identity set

environment_variables.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environment_variables.description: Timeout in milliseconds for Item Service and GraphQL requests

environment_variables.name: POWERSHELL_TIMEOUT_MS
environment_variables.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single PowerShell Remoting request

environment_variables.name: POWERSHELL_FULL_ERRORS
environment_variables.description: Set to 'true' to return the complete .NET error record instead of the shaped summary

environment_variables.name: DESCENDANTS_MAX_ITEMS
environment_variables.description: Node cap for item-service-get-item-descendants; reports truncation instead of exhausting memory

environment_variables.name: AUTHORIZATION_HEADER
environment_variables.description: If set, the HTTP transport requires an 'authorization' header matching this value
